replacements.>De texto a significado en tres pasos</d: >From text to meaning in three steps
replacements.>El modelo no procesa palabras: procesa: >The model does not process words: it processes numbers. This pipeline turns raw text into a mathematical representation where position carries semantics.
replacements.<strong>Token</strong> es la unidad míni: Token is the smallest unit the model processes. Before any computation, the text is split into pieces. A token can be a word, a syllable, or a punctuation mark.
replacements.>5 tokens — «come» se divide en «co» + «: >5 tokens — “eats” is split into “ea” + “ts” according to the tokenizer vocabulary. Each token receives a numeric ID before entering the model.
replacements.<strong>Vector</strong> es la representa: Vector is the numerical representation of a token: a list of thousands of numbers. At this point the values are arbitrary — there is no semantic geometry yet. The format exists; the semantics do not yet.
replacements.>GPT-4 usa vectores de 12 288 dimensione: >GPT-4 uses vectors with 12,288 dimensions. The values for “king” and “queen” already look close, but training creates that relationship — not the vector format itself.
replacements.<strong>Embedding</strong> es el vector: Embedding is the vector after training has adjusted it: its position in mathematical space reflects meaning. Words used in similar contexts end up geometrically close. That geometry emerged from the data itself.
replacements.>Vista 2D simplificada — el espacio real: >Simplified 2D view — the real space has thousands of dimensions. Semantic geometry emerges from millions of training examples.
replacements.>La distancia geométrica en el espacio d: >Geometric distance in embedding space captures semantic relationships. This was not programmed: it emerged from training on millions of texts.
